now-following: You are now following this post
need-one-event: Select at least one type of update, or unfollow the post.
notification-edited: %1 edited a post you follow in %2
notification-deleted: %1 deleted a post you follow in %2
notification-restored: %1 restored a post you follow in %2
no-followed-posts: You are not following any posts yet.
setting-auto-follow: Automatically follow the posts I write
setting-auto-events: Notify me about these changes to automatically followed posts:
admin-min-edit-chars-help: Edits that change fewer characters than this are treated as tiny and do not notify followers. Set 0 to notify about every edit. Default: 3.
admin-max-followed-help: The most posts a single user can follow at the same time. Set 0 for no limit. Default: 500.
admin-max-followed-why: Every followed post is stored in the database and checked each time that post changes. A limit stops one user (or a script) from following huge numbers of posts, which would bloat the database and slow the forum down. A user who reaches the limit must unfollow a post before following another, and automatic following of own posts simply stops. Existing follows are never removed.
limit-reached: You can follow up to %1 posts. Unfollow a post to follow another.
setting-auto-follow-reply: Automatically follow posts I reply to or quote
filter-no-results: No followed posts match the filter.
unfollow-unavailable-confirm: Stop following posts that were deleted or whose topic is deleted or locked?
admin-exempt-groups-help: Members of the selected groups can follow an unlimited number of posts.
event-topic: Follow topic changes (move, lock, pin, title)
notification-replied: %1 replied to a post you follow in %2
notification-topic-moved: %1 moved %2, a topic with a post you follow, to %3
notification-topic-locked: %1 locked %2, a topic with a post you follow
notification-topic-unlocked: %1 unlocked %2, a topic with a post you follow
notification-topic-pinned: %1 pinned %2, a topic with a post you follow
notification-topic-unpinned: %1 unpinned %2, a topic with a post you follow
follow-blocked: Following posts is turned off here.
bulk-skipped: %1 posts were skipped because you reached the follow limit
admin-blocked-categories-help: No bell is shown in these categories and no notifications are sent for them. Existing follows are kept.
admin-blocked-topics: Topic IDs where following is off
admin-blocked-posts: Post IDs that cannot be followed
admin-cleanup-days: Remove follows of deleted posts after (days)
admin-cleanup-days-help: A daily job removes follows of posts that no longer exist. Follows of deleted posts, or of posts in deleted topics, are removed after this many days (0 = keep them, so a restored post still notifies). Default: 30.
admin-api-help: Endpoints: GET /api/v3/plugins/post-follow/posts and GET, PUT, DELETE /api/v3/plugins/post-follow/posts/:pid. Authenticate with a NodeBB API token or a session.
admin-api-why: Lets other plugins, bots and apps follow and unfollow posts on behalf of a user through the NodeBB write API (for example an app, a script or an ActivityPub bridge). It is off by default: while off, the endpoints do not exist. Requests always act as the authenticated user and obey the same limit, privileges and blocklist as the website.
